fit_schedule: 200 identical balanced batches per arm; batch8, 4real+4sim sampled with replacement from eligible fit views; seed1703
residual_loss: mean of three SmoothL1(beta0.1): log(L/GT_L)/log1.25, log(S/GT_S)/log1.25, wrap_pi(theta-GT_theta)/(pi/18)
eligibility: TRAIN fitting only: genuine B output and original center error<15px. No online filtering, no synthetic proposals, no residual-bound exclusion.
evaluation: Initial identity and fixed final step200 only; all fixed TRAIN views retained including ineligible/missing outputs; separate fit/probe/domain/scale. Sparse TRAIN probe is not VAL or independent video generalization.
model_state_tolerance: Detector parameter and buffer SHA must be unchanged; original center/score and output count must be bitwise unchanged.
sampling_definition: Detached P3 stride8, 9x9 bilinear points, 1.5x canonical L/S context, each side at least16 input pixels. Ordinary theta0; aligned canonical B theta; padded source cells masked. Same model-coordinate logL/8,logS/8,sin2theta,cos2theta descriptor in both arms.
residual_definition: Original-coordinate long/short edge multipliers exp(log1.25*tanh(zL/S)); angle delta=(pi/18)*tanh(ztheta). If corrected L<S, project both to geometric mean and retain original canonical long direction at square tie. Original centers/scores copied bitwise; zero residual exact identity.
short_fit_review: Completion is not approval. Inspect effective gradients, all fit losses, probe joint edge/angle/RIoU changes and ordinary/aligned increment, clipping/saturation/projection, actual support previews and memory. No fitted head export or new formal/VAL/TEST command.
gt_reference_policy: Use the existing TRAIN report numeric original-coordinate GT reference for both arms and views. Current TRAIN annotation bytes must match; canonical parsed GT must allclose(reference,atol1e-3,rtol1e-5). Save reference, actual parsed numeric GT and absolute deltas; never infer equality from hashes alone.
